issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `_make_y_state(...)` (leading underscore), but both the template and the reference solution use the name `make_y_state(...)` (no underscore). This name mismatch is a structural inconsistency: students following the problem text may implement `_make_y_state` while the provided template/stubs and automated tests expect `make_y_state`, or vice versa, causing confusion or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across the problem statement, template, and solution. Either (A) change the problem statement to require `make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None`, or (B) rename the template and solution functions to `_make_y_state(...)` and update all references/tests accordingly. Ensure the tests and all task descriptions use the exact same identifier.
